shortTitle: Weight Change from Incretin-based Medications in Int J Obesity
longTitle: Weight Change from Incretin-based Weight Loss Medications across Categories of Second-Generation Antipsychotics
summary:
Using target trial emulation approaches (propensity score matching, inverse probability weighting), we estiamted weight change in the six months following semaglutide/tirzepatide prescriptions among those who were prescribed second generation antipsychotic.

A useful (and expected) finding was that patients prescribed antipsychotics with highest antipsychotic induced weight gain lost the least weight, while those prescribed antipsychotics with lower antipsychotic induced weight gain lost more weight.
citation: Varghese J.S., Goldsmith D.R. et.al. Weight Change from Incretin-based Weight Loss Medications across Categories of Second-Generation Antipsychotics. International Journal of Obesity. 2025;49:2544-2548. doi:10.1038/s41366-025-01885-4
